_comment: Controls the deployment order for this multi-solution repo.
CoreSolution must deploy first — ExtensionA and ExtensionB both depend on it.
Any solution in src/solutions/ NOT listed here is appended alphabetically.

solutions.name: CoreSolution
solutions.description: Base solution — deploy first. Contains new_Product table, security roles, and shared env variables.

solutions.name: ExtensionA
solutions.description: Order Management — depends on CoreSolution (new_Product lookup). Deploy after CoreSolution.

solutions.name: ExtensionB
solutions.description: Invoice Management — depends on CoreSolution (new_Product lookup). Deploy after CoreSolution.
